_description: Which repositories the skill creator accepts (STOP-16, section 13.2): read by scripts/check_repo_eligibility.py. Update this file, not the script, when Ably adds, renames or retires a repository. Keys starting with '_' are ignored.
_comment: namePattern is matched case-insensitively against the remote's repository name without .git. Both the legacy ably-<lang> and the renamed ably-pubsub-<lang> forms are the same repository (GitHub redirects the old URL, and local clones keep it), so both are accepted.

deny._comment: Single-token names of known non-SDK ably-<name> repositories that namePattern would accept. Legacy form only: ably-pubsub-<name> isn't denied (the definition gate still applies). Multi-hyphen names (ably-chat-swift, ably-ai-transport-js) already fail namePattern. 'pubsub' because ably-pubsub alone names no language. The second group (from brand on) comes from a survey of the ably GitHub organisation: tools, docs or stubs that a name rule alone would accept.
deny._comment-server: ably-server is an Ably-compatible server written in Go that *uses* the Go SDK. Its name looks like a language, and a usage-based gate would accept it.
deny._comment-os: ably-os is an internal MCP server in TypeScript that uses AblyRealtime; not an SDK.
deny._comment-nativescript: ably-nativescript is the legacy name of ably-js-nativescript, a wrapper that re-exports ably-js and defines no client. canonical maps it to that name (rejected by namePattern); the deny entry is a second guard.

allow._comment: Exceptions to namePattern: Pub/Sub SDK repositories whose names it rejects. Eligibility isn't scope: a capabilityOverride replaces detection only where detection can't see the SDK, and is reported as the profile's source.
allow._comment-ably-ruby-rest: ably-ruby-rest is the REST-only Ruby SDK: a gem wrapping an ably-ruby git submodule, whose entry point loads only ably/rest. Its own tree defines no client, so the definition gate and capability detection find nothing; the override supplies REST full and realtime absent.

canonical._comment: Legacy name -> current name (GitHub redirects the old one), reported as `canonical`. Both names are accepted, except where the current name fails namePattern: ably-nativescript is now ably-js-nativescript, a wrapper, so it is rejected.

plannedRename._comment: Renames in preparation, reported as `plannedRename`: either name is accepted.

definitionGate._comment: After the name rule, a REST or Realtime client entry point must be *defined* in non-test source (not just used, as load tools and servers do). With no definition: reject (NO_CLIENT_DEFINITION) when there are at least minSourceFilesToReject non-test source files, else ask (NO_SDK_FINGERPRINT: wrong path or sparse checkout?). An allow-list capabilityOverride satisfies the gate.
